description: The request that opens a graded review of a sealed lineage-record. Points at the record and at the RAW outputs it was composed from — the hits and the inventory — so every grader reads the recording, never the scribe's summary of it. Carries the record's own validation_criteria verbatim as `claims`: a review checks these; it does not restate them.

record_path.description: Path to the lineage-record under review, as sealed (the engine artifact, data and envelope).

record_sha.description: The record's content_sha. A grader that reads a different sha is grading the wrong thing.

gig_id.description: The lineage-pass gig that composed the record.

hits_dir.description: Directory holding every lineage-hit the record consumed, one file each, byte-for-byte from the store.

map_path.description: The lineage-map the record consumed (where the edge labels were assigned).

claims.description: The record's own validation_criteria, verbatim. The review tests these.

out_of_scope.description: What this review is explicitly NOT about.
